units.id: mission:Incipias: Fix Saves Missing Language|log|343|0
units.english: Noticed an alert on <ship>'s dashboard about minor data corruption. The following log entry was recovered, but the original timestamp was lost.
units.italian: Notato un avviso sul pannello della <ship> riguardo a una lieve corruzione dei dati. La seguente voce di diario è stata recuperata, ma la data originale è andata perduta.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Fix Saves Missing Language|log|344|0
units.english: Discovered that the species to the northeast of Hai space, the Incipias, are under the protection of the Quarg. Was given a translator by a Quarg in order to assist a stranded Incipias ship, but was warned not to give the Incipias any advanced technology or interfere in their development.
units.italian: Scoperto che la specie a nord-est dello spazio degli Hai, gli Incipias, è sotto la protezione dei Quarg. Ricevuto un traduttore da un Quarg per assistere una nave Incipias bloccata, ma avvertito di non dare agli Incipias alcuna tecnologia avanzata né di interferire nel loro sviluppo.

units.id: mission:Incipias: No Help For The Stranded|dialog|360|0
units.context: mission:Incipias: No Help For The Stranded
units.english: You identify the stranded alien ship you assisted earlier on your scanners, but with no way to communicate with them you are unable to help. You have no choice but to leave them to their doom on this stormy world.
units.italian: Riconosci sugli scanner la nave aliena bloccata che avevi assistito, ma senza un modo per comunicare con loro non puoi aiutarli. Non ti resta che lasciarli al loro destino su questo mondo tempestoso.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|name|364|0
units.english: Bring Incipias back to <planet>
units.italian: Riporta gli Incipias su <planet>

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|description|365|0
units.english: Bring the rescued Incipias back home to <destination>
units.italian: Riporta a casa gli Incipias salvati, su <destination>

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|blocked|369|0
units.english: You have landed on <origin>, but you don't have enough passenger space for the <bunks> Incipias. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <origin>, ma non hai abbastanza spazio passeggeri per i <bunks> Incipias. Torna qui quando avrai liberato lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|Your ship dives into the clouds of the gas giant, entering an environment on a scale you have never experienced before. Giant clouds tower like castles, sometimes opening to similarly large caverns of air. Whirlwinds brush through the atmosphere like pillars holding the sky. Though the winds are brutal, your ship glides through them as if they had no effect on it at all.|374|0
units.english: Your ship dives into the clouds of the gas giant, entering an environment on a scale you have never experienced before. Giant clouds tower like castles, sometimes opening to similarly large caverns of air. Whirlwinds brush through the atmosphere like pillars holding the sky. Though the winds are brutal, your ship glides through them as if they had no effect on it at all.
units.italian: La tua nave si tuffa tra le nuvole del gigante gassoso, entrando in un ambiente di una scala che non hai mai sperimentato prima. Nuvole gigantesche torreggiano come castelli, aprendosi talvolta in caverne d'aria altrettanto vaste. Turbini di vento spazzano l'atmosfera come pilastri che reggono il cielo. Per quanto i venti siano brutali, la tua nave ci scivola attraverso come se non avessero alcun effetto su di lei.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	Activating your scanners, you look for the stranded ship from before. Soon, a small blip appears on your radar, and you maneuver your ship to its location. The stranded ship appears, looking even worse off than the first time. The storms seem to have damaged some of the hull, and its shields are completely down; the shield generator could have gone offline when they ran out of fuel.|375|0
units.english: Activating your scanners, you look for the stranded ship from before. Soon, a small blip appears on your radar, and you maneuver your ship to its location. The stranded ship appears, looking even worse off than the first time. The storms seem to have damaged some of the hull, and its shields are completely down; the shield generator could have gone offline when they ran out of fuel.
units.italian: Attivando gli scanner, cerchi la nave bloccata di prima. Presto un piccolo segnale appare sul radar, e manovri la nave verso la sua posizione. La nave bloccata compare, in condizioni ancora peggiori della prima volta. Le tempeste sembrano aver danneggiato parte dello scafo, e gli scudi sono del tutto abbassati; il generatore di scudi potrebbe essersi spento quando sono rimasti senza carburante.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	Any attempt to hail the Incipias ship results in no answer. Carefully, you maneuver your own ship closer until you are able to dock with it.|376|0
units.english: Any attempt to hail the Incipias ship results in no answer. Carefully, you maneuver your own ship closer until you are able to dock with it.
units.italian: Qualsiasi tentativo di contattare la nave degli Incipias non ottiene risposta. Con cautela, avvicini la tua nave finché non riesci ad attraccare.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	When the airlock opens, you see five Incipias floating in front of you. They seem on guard at first, and it takes them a moment to recognize you from the previous encounter as you prepare your translation device to speak with them.|384|0
units.english: When the airlock opens, you see five Incipias floating in front of you. They seem on guard at first, and it takes them a moment to recognize you from the previous encounter as you prepare your translation device to speak with them.
units.italian: Quando il portello si apre, vedi cinque Incipias fluttuare davanti a te. All'inizio sembrano in allerta, e ci mettono un momento a riconoscerti dall'incontro precedente mentre prepari il dispositivo di traduzione per parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|label|386|0
units.english: has incipias ship
units.italian: has incipias ship

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	When the airlock opens, you see five Incipias floating in front of you. Noticing your presence, they quickly back off; they were clearly not expecting a human piloting one of their own ships. It takes them a moment to recognize you from the previous encounter as you prepare your translation device to speak with them.|387|0
units.english: When the airlock opens, you see five Incipias floating in front of you. Noticing your presence, they quickly back off; they were clearly not expecting a human piloting one of their own ships. It takes them a moment to recognize you from the previous encounter as you prepare your translation device to speak with them.
units.italian: Quando il portello si apre, vedi cinque Incipias fluttuare davanti a te. Notando la tua presenza, si ritirano in fretta; chiaramente non si aspettavano un pilota umano alla guida di una delle loro navi. Ci mettono un momento a riconoscerti dall'incontro precedente mentre prepari il dispositivo di traduzione per parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|label|388|0
units.english: initial choice
units.italian: initial choice

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Hello, I have come to save you."|390|0
units.english: "Hello, I have come to save you."
units.italian: "Salve, sono venuto a salvarvi."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"I have been sent by your people to get you home."|391|0
units.english: "I have been sent by your people to get you home."
units.italian: "Mi hanno mandato i vostri simili per riportarvi a casa."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	The Incipias seem to switch from a tense state to a surprised one, and one of them starts pulsating. "You light our language? How surprising. We would not have survived another day-moment here. You are our life-protector. We would love to talk more, but a weather-calamity is coming. We should leave now." The lack of emotion in the translation is concerning, given the content of the message.|392|0
units.english: The Incipias seem to switch from a tense state to a surprised one, and one of them starts pulsating. "You light our language? How surprising. We would not have survived another day-moment here. You are our life-protector. We would love to talk more, but a weather-calamity is coming. We should leave now." The lack of emotion in the translation is concerning, given the content of the message.
units.italian: Gli Incipias sembrano passare da uno stato teso a uno stupito, e uno di loro inizia a pulsare. "Tu luce la nostra lingua? Che sorpresa. Non saremmo sopravvissuti a un altro giorno-momento qui. Sei il nostro protettore-di-vite. Ci piacerebbe parlare ancora, ma sta arrivando una calamità-meteo. Dobbiamo andare ora." L'assenza di emozione nella traduzione è preoccupante, dato il contenuto del messaggio.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	You tell them to board your ship, and shortly after, you take off. Luckily, you leave just in time to avoid a powerful windstorm approaching the area.|393|0
units.english: You tell them to board your ship, and shortly after, you take off. Luckily, you leave just in time to avoid a powerful windstorm approaching the area.
units.italian: Di' loro di salire sulla tua nave, e poco dopo decolli. Per fortuna parti appena in tempo per evitare una potente tempesta di vento che si avvicina alla zona.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|log|396|0
units.english: The Incipias seem to be split into two groups called the Hicemus and the Conlatio; the former occupies a space station, while the latter occupies the Incipias homeworld. The Conlatio do not appear to allow outsiders on their home planet.
units.italian: Gli Incipias sembrano divisi in due gruppi, chiamati Hicemus e Conlatio; i primi occupano una stazione spaziale, i secondi il mondo d'origine degli Incipias. I Conlatio non sembrano permettere estranei sul loro pianeta natale.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|Once you land on the station, your passengers thank you again and leave, probably to get some well-earned rest. As you step out of the <ship>, another Incipias approaches you. Its scales seem worn down, and you notice intricate claw-like attachments around the end of its tentacles. "Follow me, outer-helper, before a crowd gathers. We would like to talk."|398|0
units.english: Once you land on the station, your passengers thank you again and leave, probably to get some well-earned rest. As you step out of the <ship>, another Incipias approaches you. Its scales seem worn down, and you notice intricate claw-like attachments around the end of its tentacles. "Follow me, outer-helper, before a crowd gathers. We would like to talk."
units.italian: Una volta atterrato sulla stazione, i tuoi passeggeri ti ringraziano di nuovo e se ne vanno, probabilmente per riposare come merita. Mentre scendi dalla <ship>, un altro Incipias ti si avvicina. Le sue scaglie sembrano consumate, e noti intricati attaccamenti simili ad artigli attorno all'estremità dei suoi tentacoli. "Seguimi, aiutante-esterno, prima che si raduni una folla. Vorremmo parlare."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	They guide you through the hallways so that you avoid larger groups, though they choose only horizontal corridors. You arrive in a large room with a view over the entire station, with three Incipias already present. One begins to glow.|399|0
units.english: They guide you through the hallways so that you avoid larger groups, though they choose only horizontal corridors. You arrive in a large room with a view over the entire station, with three Incipias already present. One begins to glow.
units.italian: Ti guidano attraverso i corridoi evitando i gruppi più numerosi, anche se scelgono solo corridoi orizzontali. Arrivi in una grande stanza con vista sull'intera stazione, dove sono già presenti tre Incipias. Uno comincia a brillare.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Welcome. We are the leader-governers of the Hicemus, the reigning government of the Incipias. If you agree we would like to ask you a few question-queries. In return we would be open for question-queries as well."|400|0
units.english: "Welcome. We are the leader-governers of the Hicemus, the reigning government of the Incipias. If you agree we would like to ask you a few question-queries. In return we would be open for question-queries as well."
units.italian: "Benvenuto. Siamo i capi-governatori degli Hicemus, il governo regnante degli Incipias. Se sei d'accordo, vorremmo porti alcune domande-quesiti. In cambio saremmo disposti ad ascoltare le tue domande-quesiti."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Sure, ask me something."|402|0
units.english: "Sure, ask me something."
units.italian: "Certo, chiedimi qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Sorry, but I have other stuff to do."|403|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I have other stuff to do."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma ho altro da fare."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	A green glow appears on all of them. "Thank you for taking the time-patience to speak with us. Can you tell us more about the deep space-void surrounding us?"|405|0
units.english: A green glow appears on all of them. "Thank you for taking the time-patience to speak with us. Can you tell us more about the deep space-void surrounding us?"
units.italian: Un bagliore verde appare su tutti e tre. "Grazie per averci dedicato tempo-pazienza. Puoi raccontarci di più del vuoto-spazio profondo che ci circonda?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	(Give them an exhaustive story of what I have seen so far.)|407|0
units.english: (Give them an exhaustive story of what I have seen so far.)
units.italian: (Racconta loro una storia esauriente di ciò che ho visto finora.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	(Give a rough overview of what I have seen.)|409|0
units.english: (Give a rough overview of what I have seen.)
units.italian: (Dai un quadro approssimativo di ciò che ho visto.)

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	After "seeing" your explanation, a rapid-fire sequence of colors is exchanged between the Incipias. Your translator cannot follow, so you are left watching them flash in what end up being yellow tones mixed with green and red.|410|0
units.english: After "seeing" your explanation, a rapid-fire sequence of colors is exchanged between the Incipias. Your translator cannot follow, so you are left watching them flash in what end up being yellow tones mixed with green and red.
units.italian: Dopo aver "visto" la tua spiegazione, una rapidissima sequenza di colori viene scambiata tra gli Incipias. Il tuo traduttore non riesce a seguirla, così resti a guardarli lampeggiare in quelli che finiscono per essere toni gialli mescolati a verde e rosso.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Thank you for this insight. All we gathered until now was by observing-studying stars. To think that there is so much out there... it truly raise-strengthens a determination to explore.|411|0
units.english: "Thank you for this insight. All we gathered until now was by observing-studying stars. To think that there is so much out there... it truly raise-strengthens a determination to explore.
units.italian: "Grazie per questo spunto. Tutto ciò che abbiamo raccolto finora è stato osservare-studiare le stelle. Pensare che là fuori ci sia così tanto... accresce davvero-rafforza la determinazione a esplorare.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	After "watching" your explanation, a rapid-fire sequence of colors is exchanged between the Incipias. Your translator cannot follow, so you are left watching them flash in what ends up being yellow tones mixed with green.|414|0
units.english: After "watching" your explanation, a rapid-fire sequence of colors is exchanged between the Incipias. Your translator cannot follow, so you are left watching them flash in what ends up being yellow tones mixed with green.
units.italian: Dopo aver "visto" la tua spiegazione, una rapidissima sequenza di colori viene scambiata tra gli Incipias. Il tuo traduttore non riesce a seguirla, così resti a guardarli lampeggiare in quelli che finiscono per essere toni gialli mescolati a verde.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Thank you for this profound-depth insight. All we gathered until now was by observing-studying stars close to us. To think that there is so much out there... it truly invokes a determination-will to explore.|415|0
units.english: "Thank you for this profound-depth insight. All we gathered until now was by observing-studying stars close to us. To think that there is so much out there... it truly invokes a determination-will to explore.
units.italian: "Grazie per questa visione-profonda. Tutto ciò che abbiamo raccolto finora è stato osservare-studiare le stelle a noi vicine. Pensare che là fuori ci sia così tanto... suscita davvero una determinazione-volontà a esplorare.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"But now to you. Is there anything you would like to know?"|417|0
units.english: "But now to you. Is there anything you would like to know?"
units.italian: "Ma ora tocca a te. C'è qualcosa che vorresti sapere?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Why can I not land on your home planet?"|420|0
units.english: "Why can I not land on your home planet?"
units.italian: "Perché non posso atterrare sul vostro pianeta natale?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Why do you call this station your capital?"|421|0
units.english: "Why do you call this station your capital?"
units.italian: "Perché chiamate questa stazione la vostra capitale?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"How is life on a gas giant?"|423|0
units.english: "How is life on a gas giant?"
units.italian: "Com'è la vita su un gigante gassoso?"

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"I do not have any more questions."|425|0
units.english: "I do not have any more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	A flash of red appears for only a second. "Our origin-world is not directly ruled by us. They may approach you separately at a future-point, but be careful of their lights. They have aged-time values long left-alone by us, who are progressing fast.|427|0
units.english: A flash of red appears for only a second. "Our origin-world is not directly ruled by us. They may approach you separately at a future-point, but be careful of their lights. They have aged-time values long left-alone by us, who are progressing fast.
units.italian: Un lampo rosso appare per un solo secondo. "Il nostro mondo-origine non è governato direttamente da noi. Potrebbero avvicinarti separatamente in un punto-futuro, ma attento alle loro luci. Hanno valori di tempi-antichi lasciati da parte da molto tempo da noi, che avanziamo in fretta.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	The one pulsating now takes on a bright green color, "This station is our greatest action-pride, our star-bridge. In honor of our urge to expand we made this station our capital to demonstrate our determination."|430|0
units.english: The one pulsating now takes on a bright green color, "This station is our greatest action-pride, our star-bridge. In honor of our urge to expand we made this station our capital to demonstrate our determination."
units.italian: Quello che pulsa ora assume un verde brillante, "Questa stazione è il nostro più grande orgoglio-azione, il nostro ponte-stellare. In onore del nostro impulso a espanderci abbiamo fatto di questa stazione la nostra capitale, per dimostrare la nostra determinazione."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|label|432|0
units.english: odd question
units.italian: odd question

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"What an odd-reasonable question." It's glow turns into a swirl of purple and green. "We could ask the same in return - what is it like to live on hard rock? But we understand its reasoning-origin. So let me tell you of the cloud-halls of our home-sky. Lightning will draw the most beautiful color-sings between the pillar-clouds. Between them are our cities, the most color-lifeful places you will ever see. This is a bit of a poetic-gradient description, but I do not know what else to say."|433|0
units.english: "What an odd-reasonable question." It's glow turns into a swirl of purple and green. "We could ask the same in return - what is it like to live on hard rock? But we understand its reasoning-origin. So let me tell you of the cloud-halls of our home-sky. Lightning will draw the most beautiful color-sings between the pillar-clouds. Between them are our cities, the most color-lifeful places you will ever see. This is a bit of a poetic-gradient description, but I do not know what else to say."
units.italian: "Che domanda strano-ragionevole." Il suo bagliore si trasforma in un turbine di viola e verde. "Potremmo chiedere lo stesso a te: com'è vivere su roccia dura? Ma capiamo la tua origine-ragione. Lascia che ti parli delle sale-nuvole del nostro cielo-casa. I fulmini tracceranno i più bei canti-di-colore tra le nuvole-pilastro. Tra di esse ci sono le nostre città, i luoghi più color-vitali che vedrai mai. È una descrizione un po' gradiente-poetico, ma non so cos'altro dire."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"Thank you again for your time. You have given us much to process. We hope you too have benefited from this meeting-talk."|435|0
units.english: "Thank you again for your time. You have given us much to process. We hope you too have benefited from this meeting-talk."
units.italian: "Grazie ancora per il tuo tempo. Ci hai dato molto su cui riflettere. Speriamo che anche tu abbia tratto beneficio da questo incontro-colloquio."

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	You say goodbye, and as you leave the room, you can see a rush of colors reflecting onto the walls.|436|0
units.english: You say goodbye, and as you leave the room, you can see a rush of colors reflecting onto the walls.
units.italian: Ti congedi, e mentre esci dalla stanza vedi un fiotto di colori riflettersi sulle pareti.

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|label|438|0
units.english: end no time
units.italian: end no time

units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"We are understanding-sad. Safe travels, captain." You notice a slight blue tone in the representative's communication as one of the Incipias guides you back to your ship.|439|0
units.english: "We are understanding-sad. Safe travels, captain." You notice a slight blue tone in the representative's communication as one of the Incipias guides you back to your ship.
units.italian: "Siamo comprensione-triste. Buon viaggio, capitano." Noti una lieve tonalità blu nella comunicazione del rappresentante mentre uno degli Incipias ti riaccompagna alla nave.
